note: AC zones (RULES/ac_zones.md, owner DRAFT; packages 23 D, 24 B). Grid [1][2][3]/[4][5][6]/[7][8][9], cell 5 = the character facing 1-2-3. Per cell: presets (the old AC modes this cell reproduces). The cell RULES (parry cells, Dex-loss cells, shield cells by type, ranged and parry, the Dex-loss cancel chance, the default shield hand) are rule constants of group ac_zones (constants.json), editable per character and changed by effects. mirror maps the cells of a LEFT-hand shield for the right hand. variants: the numbers a cell shows (parry = uses the parry layer where parry works; ranged = against ranged attacks).
